Thursday, November 13

Today we had a math test. It was about {{v:fractions}}. Last night, I {{g:studied|과거형: study → studied (자음+y는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -ed)}} for two hours. But I was {{v:nervous}} in the morning.

{{g:There were twenty questions|There were + 복수명사: ~들이 있었다}} on the test. The first ten questions were easy. But questions 15 and 18 were very {{v:difficult}}. I {{v:solved}} them slowly. I {{v:checked}} all my answers two times.

After lunch, Ms. Kang {{g:gave back|give back(돌려주다)의 과거형: give → gave (불규칙 동사)}} our tests. {{t:I got 90 points!}} Last month, I got 75 points. My {{v:score}} was 15 points {{g:higher|비교급: high → higher (더 높은)}}. My mom was very happy. She made pizza for dinner.

Next time, I {{g:will|will + 동사원형: ~할 것이다 (미래)}} {{v:practice}} more word problems. I {{g:want to get|want to + 동사원형: ~하고 싶다}} 100 points.

Thursday, November 13

Today our class took a math test on {{v:fractions}}. {{g:Although I studied for two hours|Although + 주어 + 동사: 비록 ~했지만 (양보)}} the night before, I was still {{v:extremely}} {{v:nervous}} when I arrived at school in the morning.

The test {{g:consisted of|consist of: ~로 이루어지다}} twenty questions. The first ten were {{g:simple enough for me to answer|형용사 + enough + for 목적어 + to부정사: ~가 …할 만큼 충분히 ~한}} quickly, but questions 15 and 18 were {{v:especially}} {{v:challenging}}. I worked through them slowly and carefully, and then I {{v:reviewed}} all of my answers twice {{g:to avoid|to부정사(목적): ~하기 위해}} {{v:careless}} mistakes.

After lunch, Ms. Kang {{v:returned}} our {{v:graded}} tests, and I {{g:found out that|find out + that절: ~라는 것을 알게 되다 (find → found)}} {{t:I received 90 points!}} {{g:Since I scored|Since + 주어 + 동사: ~이기 때문에 (이유)}} only 75 points last month, my score {{v:improved}} by 15 points. My mom was {{g:so proud of me that|so + 형용사 + that ~: 너무 ~해서 …하다}} she made pizza for dinner to {{v:celebrate}}.

From now on, I {{g:am going to practice|be going to + 동사원형: ~할 예정이다}} more word problems, because my {{v:goal}} is to {{v:earn}} a {{v:perfect}} score of 100 points next time.

questions.q: I reviewed all of my answers twice to avoid ___ mistakes.
questions.explanation: careless mistakes = 부주의한 실수

questions.q: Since I scored only 75 points last month, my score ___ by 15 points.
questions.explanation: improve(향상되다)의 과거형 improved.

questions.q: My goal is to ___ a perfect score of 100 points next time.
questions.explanation: earn은 '(노력해서) 얻다, 받다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Questions 15 and 18 were the easiest ones on the test.
questions.explanation: 'questions 15 and 18 were especially challenging' 특히 어려운 문제였다.

questions.q: Ms. Kang returned the tests after lunch.
questions.explanation: 'After lunch, Ms. Kang returned our graded tests'

questions.q: The writer scored 90 points last month.
questions.explanation: 지난달은 75점이었고, 이번에 90점을 받았다.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The test consisted of twenty questions.
The first ten were simple enough for me to answer quickly.
I reviewed all of my answers twice to avoid careless mistakes.
My mom was so proud of me that she made pizza.
From now on, I am going to practicing more word problems.
questions.answer: From now on, I am going to practicing more word problems.
questions.explanation: be going to 뒤에는 동사원형이 온다 (am going to practicing ✕ → am going to practice ○).

essays.q: Summarize the diary in one or two sentences in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: The writer was nervous about a math test, but solved the questions carefully and got 90 points. Now the writer is going to practice more to get 100 points.
essays.rubric: ① 시험·노력·점수 향상·다음 목표 중 3가지 이상 ② 문법 오류 최소화 ③ 1~2문장

essays.q: 다음 두 문장을 'so ~ that'을 사용해 한 문장으로 쓰시오: "My mom was very proud of me." / "She made pizza for dinner."
essays.sampleAnswer: My mom was so proud of me that she made pizza for dinner.
essays.rubric: ① so + 형용사 + that 구조 ② 시제 일치(과거) ③ 완전한 문장

essays.q: Why did the writer review the answers twice? Answer with 'to + 동사원형'.
essays.sampleAnswer: The writer reviewed the answers twice to avoid careless mistakes.
essays.rubric: ① to부정사(목적) 사용 ② avoid careless mistakes 내용 ③ 완전한 문장

essays.q: What is your goal for your next English test? What are you going to do? Use 'be going to'. (3 sentences)
essays.sampleAnswer: My goal is to get 95 points on my next English test. I am going to memorize ten new words every day. I am also going to review my mistakes carefully.
essays.rubric: ① be going to + 동사원형 사용 ② 목표와 계획 모두 포함 ③ 완전한 문장 3개

essays.q: Do you think checking your answers is important? Write your opinion with a reason. (3-4 sentences)
essays.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think checking my answers is very important. When I solve problems quickly, I often make careless mistakes. If I review my answers, I can find and fix them. That is why I always check my test twice.
essays.rubric: ① 찬반 의견이 분명함 ② 이유 1가지 이상 ③ 접속사(when/if/because 등) 사용 ④ 3~4문장
